identity: A mixed quiz bank: eight classical-Arabic vocabulary items of the form madha tani hadhihi al-kalima X, then twelve general-knowledge items (age of the Earth, blood groups, nitrogen in air, atomic weight, the fall of the Umayyads, gunpowder, Suq Ukaz, a riddle, the Day of Furqan, Tawfiq al-Hakim, September, Surat al-Ikhlas). 20 lines, one item per line.
law: MCQ BANK (section I): I2 stem, I3 one unit per option, I5 no cut inside an option, 0h stem runs to the LATEST point at which stem+sibling is well formed. 253 real tokens / 97 units = 2.6 per unit. Option count is NOT constant here (3, 4 or 5), so 2b gives no cross-check and every stem rests on the well-formedness test alone.
reasoning: The vocabulary block is the interesting part. The queried word belongs to the STEM, not to the options: madha tani hadhihi al-kalima HABA is the question and ghubar / faragh / rih khafifa / atiyya are the four answers - reading haba as the first option would give five siblings and no question. That is 0h applied in the direction it was applied wrongly in doc_ede30da2ee29 last batch (2g): push the stem forward through the content word. Multi-token glosses stay whole - rih khafifa, sighar al-shar, mass wa-shurb (internal wa, I5), kalam qalil - while line 2 alone has five one-word options (sari / nazif / raqiq / shaffaf / itr) because no two of them form a phrase; I marked the last two med to record that this is the one line where the count breaks the documents own 3-4 pattern. Dangling stems: @121 the printing has split the article, 78 min al-hawa mumtali BI-AL | uksijin | nitrujin..., and @185 fa-man HUWA closing a riddle whose whole clause chain (yataharrak ... wa-yujad ... wa-lakinnaka la tarahu) is ONE stem - 0h forbids cutting inside a stem however many connectives it holds, which is why wa-yujad and wa-lakinnaka do not cut. The two lines opening with a bare S (for sual) keep it inside the stem rather than treating it as an M2 label, because it is a question marker fused with the question, not a heading. Options that are proper names or titles stay whole: Tawfiq al-Hakim, Taha Husayn, Muhammad Abd al-Wahhab, ghazwat Badr, surat al-Maun; and the typing artefact hal huwa nufimbir is one option as printed.
